doc_friction.issue: The first preflight failed on another session's post (description over 160 characters) that main had already fixed; a stale base makes the 5-minute build fail for reasons outside the venture. Merging main first would have saved a run.

Screen media queries are hoisted, so any page with a prefers-color-scheme dark block fails the link audit unless its links pass on both backgrounds; nothing in the venture docs says static pages should not ship a dark mode.

regen.mjs said 'The served surface is current' while front-door-tools.test.mjs failed on a stale 00-mirror-alias.conf and shard mount list; a new venture needs `node platform/marketing/front-door-tools.mjs --write` too, and that command also writes an untracked gitops/prod/front-door-tools/ directory that must not be committed.

Preflight passed while five repo-wide count and mirror checks (sync_tree_counts.py, front-door-tools --write, siblings orphan budget, ink contrast, entities table) were still red for a new venture; a new-venture checklist naming those scripts would have saved four CI rounds.

On a busy main, a new-venture PR conflicts on every hand-written count and mirror file whenever another venture lands; a conflicted PR silently gets no CI. Taking main's side then re-running the sync scripts is the recipe, and it is not written down.
